comments.text: The woman in the eye video was using a contact lens removal tool to remove what appeared to be a scleral contact lens (a large-diameter lens that has its edges on the white of the eye). Tip from someone who wears RGP (rigid gas-permeable) scleral lenses, you want to put the suction cup to one side of the lens to help break the suction easier. I usually aim for the bottom outer edge of my iris (middle of the downward slope of my lens). Also, if you put the tool directly in the center of the lens and blink a few times with it stuck there, your eyes may water a little and your eyelids will help pop the tool off. Sounds scary, and it kinda is the first time, but you get used to the weirdness.
